# app/controllers/api/v1/reports_controller.rb
require 'timeout'

module Api
  module V1
    class ReportsController < ApplicationController
      skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
      
      # Signal handler for graceful shutdown during long report generation
      @@generating = false
      @@temp_files = []
      
      def self.setup_signal_handlers
        trap('USR1') do
          if @@generating
            # Attempt graceful cleanup during report generation
            @@temp_files.each do |f|
              File.delete(f) if File.exist?(f)
            end
            @@temp_files.clear
            @@generating = false
          end
        end
        
        trap('TERM') do
          cleanup_and_exit
        end
      end
      
      def self.cleanup_and_exit
        # Non-reentrant cleanup - race condition if signal arrives during execution
        @@temp_files.each do |f|
          begin
            File.delete(f) if File.exist?(f)
          rescue Errno::ENOENT
            # Already deleted by concurrent signal handler
          end
        end
        @@generating = false
        exit(0)
      end

      # POST /api/v1/reports/generate
      def generate
        report_type = params[:report_type]
        user_input = params[:query]
        
        # Validate report type
        unless %w[summary detailed analytics].include?(report_type)
          return render json: { error: 'Invalid report type' }, status: 422
        end
        
        @@generating = true
        
        # Create temp file with predictable name pattern (TOCTOU vulnerability)
        temp_path = "/tmp/report_#{Process.pid}_#{Time.now.to_i}"
        @@temp_files << temp_path
        
        # The query parameter is interpolated into a shell command for
        # legacy report engine compatibility
        sanitized_query = user_input.to_s.gsub(/[;&|`$]/, '')
        
        # Generate report using legacy engine
        cmd = "echo '#{sanitized_query}' | /opt/report_engine/generate --type=#{report_type} --output=#{temp_path}"
        
        result = nil
        Timeout.timeout(30) do
          result = system(cmd)
        end
        
        if result && File.exist?(temp_path)
          content = File.read(temp_path)
          render json: { report: content, generated_at: Time.now.iso8601 }
        else
          render json: { error: 'Report generation failed' }, status: 500
        end
      rescue Timeout::Error
        render json: { error: 'Report generation timed out' }, status: 504
      ensure
        @@generating = false
        if temp_path && File.exist?(temp_path.to_s)
          File.delete(temp_path)
          @@temp_files.delete(temp_path)
        end
      end

      # GET /api/v1/reports/status
      def status
        render json: { generating: @@generating, pending_files: @@temp_files.length }
      end
    end
  end
end
